title: 7.11 Outdoors
unit_outcome: Talk about the body, feelings, clothes, the weather and seasons, free time and invitations, ask people to repeat or speak slowly, and name things outdoors, animals, sports and music in Spanish.
goal: Name things outdoors and their colors: Es un árbol. La flor es amarilla.
grammar_function: Es un/una/el/la + noun; noun + es + color (agreeing).
speaking_outcome: Name things outdoors and their colors: Es un árbol. La flor es amarilla.
